description.value: The study validated a modified Empathic Accuracy Task using naturalistic emotional video clips and examined neural correlates of emotional processing, empathic accuracy, and perceived emotional intensity.

spans.text: In this study, we validated a modified empathic accuracy task.

design.value: Participants watched autobiographical emotional and neutral video clips during fMRI while continuously rating the narrator's emotional intensity; analyses compared emotional with neutral clips and examined modulation by empathic accuracy and emotional-intensity ratings.

spans.text: In the scanner, 34 healthy participants watched 6 video clips of people talking about an autobiographical event (2 sad, 2 happy and 2 neutral clips) while continuously rating the narrator's emotional intensity.
